longDescription: The datacenter is the heartbeat of your digital infrastructure. Every application, every workload, every transaction ultimately depends on the availability, performance, and security of the physical and virtual environment that hosts it. Akamco designs and builds datacenter environments that are engineered to remain operational under real-world conditions — not just on paper.

We engage from concept through commissioning: site selection and raised floor design; server, storage, and networking infrastructure; hypervisor and virtualisation platforms; precision cooling and power distribution; and structured cabling to TIA-568 standards. Every layer is specified with redundancy, capacity growth, and operational maintainability in mind.

Our engineering team holds vendor accreditations across HPE, Dell Technologies, Cisco, APC, Vertiv, and Schneider Electric — giving us the freedom to recommend the platform that best fits your requirements rather than the one that pays us the most margin.

title: Advanced Fiber Measurement Solutions
tagline: Real-time fiber monitoring. Proactive fault localisation.
description: Real-time fiber monitoring and proactive fault localization solutions for carrier and enterprise fiber networks.
outcomes: Sub-metre fault localisation on live fiber
Proactive alerts before service-affecting degradation
Centralised visibility across all fiber spans
Reduced mean time to repair (MTTR)
longDescription: Fiber networks are the backbone of modern telecommunications and enterprise connectivity — but their physical nature makes them uniquely vulnerable to degradation, cuts, and intrusion events that are invisible without the right measurement tools. Akamco deploys advanced fiber measurement and monitoring solutions that give operators real-time visibility into the health of every span.

Our OTDR monitoring systems continuously inject test pulses into live fiber, detecting reflections that indicate connector degradation, bends, splices, and physical cuts — with sub-metre fault localisation accuracy. Filtered 1650nm monitoring technology allows testing without interfering with live traffic, enabling 24/7 proactive diagnostics on in-service fibers.

Centralised fiber management platforms aggregate measurements from distributed OTDRs and optical power monitors across the entire network, correlating alarms and dispatching field teams with precise fault coordinates — transforming reactive repair into proactive maintenance.

features.title: Preventive Diagnostics
features.description: Trend analysis of fiber health metrics over time to identify gradual degradation before it reaches service-affecting threshold — enabling planned maintenance rather than emergency repair.

longDescription: Perimeter security is the first physical barrier between a protected facility and an unauthorised or hostile vehicle. For government compounds, military installations, embassies, energy infrastructure, and critical facilities, the consequences of perimeter failure are catastrophic. Akamco designs and installs certified vehicle and pedestrian access control systems — from hydraulic road blockers to biometric turnstiles — that operate reliably under continuous operational conditions.

Our perimeter product range covers hydraulic road blockers rated to IWA-14 and PAS 68 vehicle impact standards; automatic barriers and retractable bollards for traffic management; full-height and half-height turnstiles for pedestrian access control; and sliding and swing security gates with electromagnetic locking and interlock control logic. All systems are integrated with ANPR, access control, and video surveillance at the operator console.

Civil and electrical coordination is managed in-house — our teams design the foundation works, conduit routes, and power supply circuits in parallel with the above-ground equipment design, reducing coordination risk and construction programme delays.

longDescription: A control room is the nerve centre of any large-scale monitoring and management operation — and the quality of its design directly determines the quality of operator decision-making under pressure. Akamco designs and builds control rooms and command centres that combine ergonomic workstation environments, high-performance video wall technology, and resilient signal distribution infrastructure.

We design the complete physical environment: video wall systems using LED or LCD display technology, operator console furniture to ISO 11064 ergonomic standards, KVM and signal distribution matrices for managing multiple sources across multiple workstations, and IP-based AV over fibre infrastructures that scale to any room size or source count.

For security operations centres (SOC) and network operations centres (NOC), we layer the technology design with workflow consulting — defining alarm management procedures, escalation paths, and shift handover processes that make the technology investment genuinely effective.

longDescription: Visual communication technology has transformed the way organisations engage employees, customers, and the public. Akamco designs and installs AV systems that make that technology work reliably — from a single conference room display to a multi-screen outdoor LED billboard visible from 200 metres.

Our AV scope covers indoor fine-pitch LED video walls for lobbies, boardrooms, and trading floors; outdoor LED screens rated to IP65 for advertising and wayfinding; LCD display walls for control rooms and monitoring environments; digital signage networks with centralised content management; and integrated conference room AV including interactive displays, video conferencing, and wireless presentation systems.

We manage every aspect of the installation: structural support design for large-format displays, signal distribution planning, content management system configuration, and ongoing technical support — so the technology performs as impressively on day 1,000 as it does on day one.

longDescription: Energy costs represent a significant and growing operational expense for government facilities, industrial plants, and commercial buildings. Renewable energy systems — when properly engineered — provide a quantifiable reduction in grid electricity consumption, meaningful carbon emission reductions, and a degree of energy independence that improves operational resilience.

Akamco's renewable energy practice covers solar PV system design and installation for rooftop and ground-mount applications; hybrid energy systems combining solar, battery storage, and grid or diesel backup; battery energy storage system (BESS) design and commissioning; and energy monitoring and optimisation platforms that continuously analyse generation, consumption, and storage to maximise value.

Our energy engineers hold IEC 62109 and IEEE 1547 compliance expertise and produce bankable engineering reports that satisfy project finance, insurance, and authority approval requirements. Every system we commission is performance-tested against the design model — and monitored in real time thereafter.

title: UPS & Critical Power Solutions
description: Reliable UPS and critical power protection solutions for mission-critical infrastructure — from modular datacenter UPS to industrial power distribution.
outcomes: Continuous clean power to every critical load
N+1 or 2N redundancy eliminating single points of failure
Predictive battery management preventing unexpected failures

longDescription: Power failure is not just an inconvenience — for datacenters, hospitals, industrial control systems, and government facilities, it is a catastrophic event with financial, operational, and potentially life-safety consequences. Akamco designs and delivers critical power solutions that eliminate single points of failure and keep sensitive equipment powered through any grid disturbance.

Our UPS scope covers online double-conversion UPS from 1 kVA single-phase units through multi-megawatt modular three-phase systems — with N+1 and 2N redundancy configurations, static transfer switches, and automatic bypass. We work with APC by Schneider Electric, Eaton, Vertiv, and Socomec — selecting the platform that best matches your availability requirement and total cost of ownership.

Beyond UPS, we design and install the full critical power distribution chain: power distribution units with outlet-level metering, busbar and cable distribution systems, transfer switches, and power quality analysers. Every installation is validated with a resistive load bank test before live loads are connected.

features.description: Online double-conversion UPS systems providing complete isolation from grid-borne disturbances — with unity power factor output, wide input voltage window, and SNMP/remote monitoring capability.

features.title: Modular UPS Systems
